text:
sara: Quick sync — ran an extended burn-in (48h) on node gpu-130 after Xid spikes earlier today. Posting notes and next steps.
ajay: Thanks — can you paste the tail of the dmesg / Xid pattern?
sara: sure, snippet below shows repeated Xid 31 then ECC corrected counts increasing.
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 31, PID: 2154 GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 12346.012345] nvidia: GPU 0000:3b:00: GPU has a pending ECC error (corrected)
```
ajay: looks like transient bus hangs + corrected ECC. How did it behave under stress?
sara: ran soakbench with these flags: `./soakbench --gpu 3b:00 --duration 48h --memtest --random-load` — we saw 3 soft ECC increments at ~12h, then Xid around 28h, then stable for remainder.
dave: Did you try disabling P2P or power capping? sometimes reduces flakiness.
sara: tried setting power_limit to 250W for 24h, no change in Xid frequency. P2P disabled during run.
carla: What's the current node state in k8s? still cordoned?
sara: Cordoned and drained before burn-in: `kubectl cordon gpu-130 && kubectl drain gpu-130 --ignore-daemonsets` then re-run soak tests.
ajay: Good. Any thermal anomalies? temp logs?
sara: temps peaked at 78C under load, ambient 22C, no thermal throttling events.
soak-bot: soakbench summary uploaded: https://redwood/soak/1834561234/report — 48h, 1 Xid, 3 ECC-corrected, 0 unrecoverable.
dave: Given 1 Xid and corrected ECCs, what's our threshold to return to pool? Current policy: >=2 Xids or any unrecoverable => replace. Otherwise extended soak 7d if recurring.
sara: propose quarantining node for 7d continuous soak (no k8s), then re-evaluate if Xid recurs. If none, return to pool.
carla: cost/availability tradeoff: we need capacity this week in us-west. If we hold for 7d we'll lose throughput. Suggest we repro in isolated rack (spare capacity) for 72h more and if clean then return.
ajay: agree on compromise: 72h isolated soak, if Xid count stays at 0 and corrected ECCs <=5, we mark as passed and reintroduce with monitored flag. If Xid >=1, escalate replacement.
sara: I'll kick off 72h run now and attach live logs to the incident. Will label node with `soak:monitored` when returning.
dave: Also file RMA request template in case replacement required: include serial, last-bit error counts, and soak logs.
carla: noted — please ping infra-ops if we need to pull spare GPUs from staging.
sara: starting run `soakbench --gpu 3b:00 --duration 72h --logstream https://logs.redwood/gpu-130` — will update in thread. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
soak-bot: soak run started at 1834562000, expected end 1834782800. Logs are live.
sara: thanks — updating ticket INF-4422 with these steps.
carla: sgtm. If we hit another Xid during 72h, immediate drain+mark for replacement.
ajay: add an automatic alert to oncall if Xid count >0 during reintegration window.
sara: added alert rule and a quick eval prompt to catch regressions in downstream quality tests.
soak-bot: note: maintenance window request for physical replacement if needed must go through facilities 48h lead time.
sara: yep will coordinate. Will post final verdict in this thread after 72h.
